desc:
The full version of DOORS Paradox.

In an alternative DOORS universe...
After escaping the mines, and you try to enter whatever lies next... a mysterious force stops and sends you else where...

⚠️Epilepsy, sound, and flashing lights warning 

🎧 Headphones recommended
📷 Max graphics recommended 
❤️ Join the Project' Inc. group to support us! 
⭐Buy (and wear) our merch 
🎵 All music is non-copyright 

💫 All credits are displayed in-game 

Inspired by LSPLASH’s “DOORS,” "Nicorocks’s “Rooms”, MasterSwordRemix’s “Undertale Yellow”
Thumbnails by @unsurprise & @wolfie
